name: onlinereaderframework
description: A React reader framework for publishing a book as a readable, searchable, accessible web edition.
author: Dominik Lukeš

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix packages/reader-core && npm ci --prefix apps/reader-demo
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/reader-core && npm run build --prefix apps/reader-demo
scripts.test: npm run test:publication-content --prefix packages/reader-core && npm run test:agent-export --prefix packages/reader-core && node --test packages/reader-core/src/original/test-original-reader.mjs packages/reader-core/src/original/test-publication-navigation.mjs packages/reader-core/src/original/test-outline-preference.mjs packages/reader-core/src/original/reading-support/test-reading-preferences.mjs packages/reader-core/src/original/toolbar/test-toolbar-model.mjs packages/reader-core/src/original/test-reader-theme.mjs packages/reader-core/src/original/frontpage/test-frontpage.mjs packages/reader-core/src/original/listening/test-reader-listening.mjs packages/reader-core/src/original/read-aloud/test-read-aloud.mjs && npm run test:books && npm run test:release --prefix apps/reader-demo
